title: Creamy Shrimp Malabar
description: A rich and flavorful Indian-inspired shrimp dish with a creamy malaysian-inspired sauce, served with a gratin crust. Perfect for a special occasion or a romantic dinner.
instructions: Season the shrimp with salt and pepper.
In a large skillet, heat the butter over medium-high heat.
Add the shrimp and cook until pink, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Remove the shrimp from the skillet and set aside.
In the same skillet, add the curry paste and cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Pour in the malaysian cream and bring to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and let sauce simmer for 2-3 minutes.
Stir in the parmesan cheese until melted.
Transfer the shrimp to a baking dish and spoon the sauce over the top.
Top with a layer of grated parmesan cheese and a sprinkle of chopped cilantro.
Bake in the preheated oven for 5-7 minutes, or until the cheese is golden brown and bubbly.
Serve immediately and garnish with additional cilantro if desired.
